name: Quests Expanded
author: MT2 Tools
description: Overhauls quests. Quest givers hand players on to each other across regions, forming named questlines with chapters; a main questline players of any level follow; a Quests report with each line's players, chapters and quests. Chapters are rated: great ones cheer players up, poor ones let them down, and players ask releases for new story chapters, more so the more of them love story.
